verdict.rationale: Formant is an API-driven fleet platform (Admin API, Cloud SDK), so scoped credentials are a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents issuing API keys, service accounts, or permission-scoped tokens for an agent. The 'Formant agent' material covers device provisioning and data-stream configuration, not least-privilege API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
